attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3094/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's Jacob folders is this man, and the `jacob-tsalikis` of 22 November is a Greek of the twentieth century. The page's authority is named and is a first-hand one: Theodoret of Cyrus, who it says knew the venerable man personally, in the Philotheos Historia, number 21. It gives no year and no century, so no `dates` object is proposed; the city of Cyrus is named but no `locations` are proposed from it. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
